name: Pad prik gaeng pork
notes: Eating Thai Food (300 g chicken, 3 long beans, 3 tbsp red curry paste, 1 tsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1 tbsp oil) and ImportFood Pad Ped Mu (4 plates: 1 lb pork belly, 2 cups long beans, 1/2 cup peppers, 3 tbsp paste, 3 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp palm sugar). Per plate 18 g of paste (one tablespoon), 15 g of oil; the sauce is a little water. Protein is the cooked weight.
